notes: Fixes a bug I shipped and did not catch: the new row factors were UNREACHABLE. A factor and a bodyweight gate are two separate decisions, and the row variants were not in the gate list, so the numbers were set and never used. Every new factor now has to prove its gate is open in the test, not just that the number was assigned
Values: incline/upright row 0.37, feet-elevated row 0.79, inverted row 0.60, knee push-up 0.49 (two-study consensus), push-ups 0.64, incline 0.55, decline 0.74, incline crunches 0.85
